missions.title: The adhan and the rows
missions.kicker: Worship · The adhan and the rows
missions.button: Yunus the muezzin wants to show you something

a.text: Yunus the muezzin climbs to call the adhan and beckons you to follow. “When you hear me, say what I say. After 'come to prayer', say: there is no power and no strength except with Allah.”

b.text: Inside, Idris walks along the row before the prayer, pressing shoulders together and nudging feet into line. “Straight rows,” he says. “Shoulder to shoulder. No gaps.”
